description: Two overlapping radar shapes with a legend beneath that names each series.
overview: Uses `RadarChart` with `cy="45%"` and `outerRadius="62%"` to leave room below, a `ChartLegend` with `verticalAlign="bottom"` rendering `ChartLegendContent`, a `PolarGrid`, a `PolarAngleAxis` on `skill`, and two `Radar` series (`lastMonth`, `thisMonth`) at `fillOpacity={0.2}`. `chartData` holds six `{ skill, thisMonth, lastMonth }` records. `chartConfig` colors `thisMonth` with `var(--green)` and `lastMonth` with `var(--gray)`. The tooltip uses `ChartTooltipContent` with `indicator="line"` and `cursor={false}`.
usage: Replace `chartData` with one record per axis, keeping a category key for `PolarAngleAxis dataKey` and a numeric key per series. Rename series in `chartConfig` and in the `var(--color-<key>)` references on each `Radar`. The legend reads labels and colors from `chartConfig`. Adjust `cy` and `outerRadius` together if the legend overlaps the chart in a shorter container.
notes: `accessibilityLayer` is set on `RadarChart`, so the chart is focusable and arrow keys move between axes.
